title: antsAtroposN4.sh
description: antsAtroposN4.sh iterates between N4 <-> Atropos to improve segmentation results.

input_image.description: Anatomical image, typically T1. If more than one anatomical image is specified, subsequent images are also used during the segmentation process.
input_image.title: Input Image

mask_image.description: Binary mask defining the region of interest.
mask_image.title: Mask Image

number_of_classes.description: Number of classes defining the segmentation.
number_of_classes.title: Number of Segmentation Classes

max_n4_atropos_iterations.description: Maximum number of (outer loop) iterations between N4 <-> Atropos (default = 15).
max_n4_atropos_iterations.title: Max. N4 <-> Atropos Iterations

max_atropos_iterations.description: Maximum number of (inner loop) iterations in Atropos (default = 3).
max_atropos_iterations.title: Max. Atropos Iterations

segmentation_priors_pattern.description: Prior probability images initializing the segmentation. Specified using c-style formatting, e.g. -p labelsPriors%02d.nii.gz. If this is not specified, k-means initialization is used instead.
segmentation_priors_pattern.title: Segmentation Priors

segmentation_priors.description: Prior probability images initializing the segmentation. Specified using c-style formatting, e.g. -p labelsPriors%02d.nii.gz. If this is not specified, k-means initialization is used instead.
segmentation_priors.title: Segmentation Priors

mrf.description: Specifies MRF prior (of the form '[ weight,neighborhood ]', e.g. '[ 0.1,1x1x1 ]' which is default).
mrf.title: MRF

posterior_formulation.description: Posterior formulation and whether or not to use mixture model proportions. e.g 'Socrates[ 1 ]' (default) or 'Aristotle[ 1 ]'.  Choose the latter if you want to use the distance priors, see also the -l option for label propagation control (default = 'Socrates[ 1 ]').
posterior_formulation.title: Posterior Formulation

label_propagation.description:
Incorporate a distance prior into the 'Aristotle' posterior formulation. Should be of the form 'label[ lambda,boundaryProbability ]' where label is a value of 1,2,3,... denoting label ID. The label probability for anything outside the current label

  = boundaryProbability * exp( -lambda * distanceFromBoundary )

Intuitively, smaller lambda values will increase the spatial capture range of the distance prior. To apply to all label values, simply omit specifying the label, i.e. -l '[ lambda,boundaryProbability ]'.
label_propagation.title: Label Propagation

posterior_label_for_n4_weight_mask.description: Which posterior probability image should be used to define the N4 weight mask. Can also specify multiple posteriors in which case the chosen posteriors are combined.
posterior_label_for_n4_weight_mask.title: Posterior Label for N4 Weight Mask

image_file_suffix.description: Any of the standard ITK IO formats e.g. nrrd, nii.gz (default), mhd.
image_file_suffix.title: Image File Suffix

keep_temporary_files.description: Keep temporary files on disk (1) or delete them (0) (default = 0).
keep_temporary_files.title: Keep Temporary Files

use_random_seeding.description: Use random number generated from system clock in Atropos (default = 1).
use_random_seeding.title: Use Random Seeding

atropos_segmentation_prior_weight.description: Atropos spatial prior probability weight for the segmentation (default = 0.25).
atropos_segmentation_prior_weight.title: Atropos Prior Segmentation Weight

n4_convergence.description: Convergence parameters for N4, see '-c' option in N4BiasFieldCorrection (default = [50x50x50x50,0.0000001]).
n4_convergence.title: N4 Convergence

n4_bspline_params.description: N4 b-spline specification, see '-b' option in N4BiasFieldCorrection (default = [200,0,0,0]).
n4_bspline_params.title: N4 B-spline Parameters

atropos_segmentation_icm.description: ICM parameters for segmentation, see '-g' option in Atropos (default = [1,1]).
atropos_segmentation_icm.title: Atropos ICM

atropos_segmentation_use_euclidean_dista.description: Use euclidean distances in distance prior formulation (1) or not (0), see Atropos usage for details (default = 1).
atropos_segmentation_use_euclidean_dista.title: Atropos Use Euclidean Distance

test_debug_mode.description: If > 0, attempts to continue after errors.
test_debug_mode.title: Test / Debug Mode
